blind.description: A freestanding architectural roof dormer featuring a classical pedimented facade with an arched four-pane window flanked by pilasters on a molded stone base. The structure has a pitched gabled roof with dark slate tiles and a rounded ridge cap with decorative banding. The sides and rear are clad in dark slate/paneling. Surfaces are clean, solid, and fully textured in a hand-painted/stylized art style.
blind.from_above: A rectangular pitched roof with slate tiles, divided down the middle by a cylindrical ridge cap with raised circular bands, with a sliver of the light-colored pediment trim visible along one edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
